dimensions.assessment: Applies to federal records, maps, regulations, and local signage associated with the specific interpretive center in Wyoming.
dimensions.evidence: The National Historic Trails Interpretive Center established under section 2(a) of Public Law 105-290 (112 Stat. 2783) in Casper, Wyoming, shall be known and designated as the 'Barbara L. Cubin National Historic Trails Interpretive Center'.

dimensions.assessment: Purely administrative redesignation with no impact on private citizens or substantive program operations.
No federal spending, appropriations, or revenue changes are mentioned in the source material.
Narrow technical name change affecting legal references, maps, and documents pertaining to one facility.
dimensions.evidence: Any reference in a law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the National Historic Trails Interpretive Center... shall be deemed to be a reference to the new name.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent renaming of the facility and adjustment of all future federal records.

missing_information: Cost of updating physical signs and official documentation.
importance_detail.rationale: This enacted public law renames the National Historic Trails Interpretive Center in Casper, Wyoming, creating only administrative and record-keeping changes.
